bullets.text: Led a team of 5 engineers to ship the checkout redesign.
Reduced page load time by 40% through backend caching improvements.
Designed REST APIs serving 3 million users.
Automated the release pipeline (CI/CD), saving 10 hours per week.
Wrote integration tests that caught 12 regressions before release, improving reliability.
Resolved a critical production outage affecting 10000 users within 30 minutes.
Migrated the database from MySQL to PostgreSQL with zero downtime.
Cut deployment time from 30 minutes to 5 minutes, improving deployment reliability.
Built an internal tool adopted by 50 engineers across the company.
Presented quarterly roadmap updates to 20 stakeholders across teams.
Onboarded 4 new hires onto the platform team.
